s1.syndrome_frame: A slowly growing vascular tumor on the scalp
salient_findings: 8-mm red, firm, mobile nodule on the left temporal scalp
Irregular red lacunae with irregular vessels and absence of septa on dermoscopic evaluation
Well-circumscribed dermal vascular tumor with ectatic thin-walled vessels and intravascular branching papillary structures on histopathology
key_facts: The patient is a man in his 40s
The patient has no significant medical history
The tumor is located on the left temporal scalp
The tumor is 8-mm in size
The tumor is red, firm, and mobile
Dermoscopic evaluation shows irregular red lacunae and irregular vessels
Histopathology shows a well-circumscribed dermal vascular tumor
The tumor extends to the superficial subcutaneous tissue
The tumor is composed of ectatic thin-walled vessels with intravascular branching papillary structures
The endothelial cells have numerous intracytoplasmic eosinophilic hyaline globules
PAS staining is positive for hyaline globules in the cytoplasm of endothelial cells
Tumor vessels are positive for CD-31 and negative for D2-40 and HHV-8

per_call: Pleomorphic Hyalinizing Angiectatic Tumor of Soft Parts

shortlist.label: Hobnail Hemangioma
shortlist.why_kept: Matches dermoscopic and histopathological findings of a well-circumscribed dermal vascular tumor with ectatic thin-walled vessels and intravascular branching papillary structures

shortlist.label: Papillary Hemangioma
shortlist.why_kept: Shares similar histopathological features with hobnail hemangioma, including papillary structures and ectatic vessels

shortlist.label: Pyogenic Granuloma
shortlist.why_kept: Common vascular tumor that can present as a red, firm, and mobile nodule, although histopathology is less consistent with this diagnosis

shortlist.label: Targetoid Hemosiderotic Hemangioma
shortlist.why_kept: Also known as hobnail hemangioma, this diagnosis is supported by the clinical and histopathological findings

shortlist.label: Cherry Hemangioma
shortlist.why_kept: Although less likely, cherry hemangioma is a common benign vascular tumor that can present as a red, firm nodule

raw.rationale: The presence of ectatic thin-walled vessels with intravascular branching papillary structures, endothelial cells with numerous intracytoplasmic eosinophilic hyaline globules, and positive PAS staining are characteristic features of Hobnail Hemangioma.

rejected.label: Papillary Hemangioma
rejected.why: While it shares some features, the specific combination of histopathological findings and dermoscopic evaluation points more towards Hobnail Hemangioma.

rejected.label: Pyogenic Granuloma
rejected.why: Typically presents with a more rapid growth and history of trauma, which is not mentioned in the case.

rejected.label: Targetoid Hemosiderotic Hemangioma
rejected.why: Although similar, the specific histological features described are more characteristic of Hobnail Hemangioma.

rejected.label: Cherry Hemangioma
rejected.why: Cherry hemangiomas are typically small, bright red, and have a different histological appearance than what is described.
